arguments.explanation: Flags transactions whose timestamp falls from 01:00 up to and including 04:59 on any day in the data.
assumptions: Time is the transaction's own timestamp in transactions.date, with no timezone conversion.
'Up to and including 04:59' means any transaction whose hour is 01, 02, 03 or 04.
The window applies to every day in the data (2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31).
